story.text: 승객 여러분, 환영합니다. 전주의 향기로운 밥상 위로 날아가 볼까요?
story.reading: seung-gaek yeo-reo-bun, hwan-yeong-ham-ni-da. jeon-ju-ui hyang-gi-ro-un bap-sang wi-ro nal-a-ga bol-kka-yo?
story.en: Welcome, passengers. Shall we fly over Jeonju's fragrant dining table?

story.text: 전주 하면 가장 먼저 떠오르는 음식, '비빔밥'이에요. 여러 나물과 고기, 달걀을 밥 위에 얹고 비벼 먹는답니다.
story.reading: jeon-ju ha-myeon ga-jang meon-jeo tteo-o-reu-neun eum-sik, bi-bim-bap-i-e-yo. yeo-reo na-mul-gwa go-gi, dal-gyal-eul bap wi-e eonj-go bi-byeo meok-neun-dam-ni-da.
story.en: The first food that comes to mind with Jeonju is 'bibimbap'. You put various namul, meat, and egg on rice and mix it all together before eating.

story.text: 전주 비빔밥에는 특별히 '콩나물'이 들어가요. 아삭한 식감과 고소한 맛을 더해주지요.
story.reading: jeon-ju bi-bim-bap-e-neun teuk-byeol-hi kong-na-mul-i deul-eo-ga-yo. a-sak-han sik-gam-gwa go-so-han mas-eul deo-hae-ju-ji-yo.
story.en: Jeonju bibimbap especially includes 'bean sprouts'. They add a crunchy texture and nutty flavor.

story.text: 그릇을 알록달록 채우는 건 바로 '나물'이에요. 고사리, 시금치처럼 손질한 채소를 양념해 무친 반찬이랍니다.
story.reading: geu-reus-eul al-lok-dal-lok chae-u-neun geon ba-ro na-mul-i-e-yo. go-sa-ri, si-geum-chi-cheo-reom son-jil-han chae-so-reul yang-nyeom-hae mu-chin ban-chan-i-ram-ni-da.
story.en: What fills the bowl with color is 'namul'. It's a seasoned side dish made from prepared vegetables like bracken and spinach.

story.text: 마지막으로 매콤한 '고추장'을 한 숟갈 넣어요. 전주는 예로부터 고추장 맛이 좋기로 유명한 고장이에요.
story.reading: ma-ji-mag-eu-ro mae-kom-han go-chu-jang-eul han sut-gal neoh-eo-yo. jeon-ju-neun ye-ro-bu-teo go-chu-jang mas-i joh-gi-ro yu-myeong-han go-jang-i-e-yo.
story.en: Finally, add a spoonful of spicy 'gochujang'. Jeonju has long been famous for its delicious gochujang.

story.text: 예로부터 전주에서는 '반찬'을 열두 가지나 차린 12첩 반상을 즐겼어요. 그만큼 음식을 정성껏 대접하는 고장이랍니다.
story.reading: ye-ro-bu-teo jeon-ju-e-seo-neun ban-chan-eul yeol-du ga-ji-na cha-rin yeol-du-cheob ban-sang-eul jeulg-yeo-sseo-yo. geu-man-keum eum-sig-eul jeong-seong-kkeot dae-jeob-ha-neun go-jang-i-ram-ni-da.
story.en: Since long ago, Jeonju enjoyed a 12-dish table set with as many as twelve 'banchan' (side dishes). That's how much this region takes pride in serving food with care.

story.text: 자, 맛있는 다섯 단어를 모두 맛보셨나요? 이제 문제를 풀며 꼭꼭 씹어 확인해봐요!
story.reading: ja, mas-it-neun da-seot dan-eo-reul mo-du mat-bo-syeot-na-yo? i-je mun-je-reul pul-myeo kkok-kkok ssib-eo hwag-in-hae-bwa-yo!
story.en: Now, have you tasted all five delicious words? Let's check by chewing through some questions!

words.example_en: Namul is a side dish made of vegetables.
It becomes spicy when you add gochujang.
There are as many as twelve side dishes.
Bean sprouts are Jeonju's special ingredient.

sentences.en: Bibimbap is eaten by mixing many ingredients.
Namul is a vegetable that is good for the body.
Side dishes are arranged in various colors.
